plate_comment: Boot initialization of the ambient conditions module (e2m 1921 / 1977): presets the lookup caches, starts the ambient air flow and ambient air temperature filters from the current values, sets the first compressor_inlet_temperature_rise, ambient_air_temperature_estimate, ambient air temperature and its source, the barometric pressure reference and the compressor inlet pressure, the relative humidity and the altitude (was cm848_initialization_step_3)
